panels.title: Review Provider Evidence
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Saved provider evidence for this Run ID. Cached Bronze means the provider API was not called: Check performed is No and Check result is —. Provider check identifies saved preflight evidence, not the extraction transport. UNKNOWN means the performed state or result is unknown. Since completed is elapsed wall time from the saved completion timestamp, updated on refresh. Expand Provider HTTP details for recorded response time, HTTP status and endpoint; missing details are not invented. VALID EMPTY is an empty successful response. SELECT RUN requires context; QUERY ERROR is a failed request. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure indicates an unavailable source and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response.

panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Saved provider check result via check_result_display. Cached Bronze (provider API not called) shows —. Missing evidence stays UNKNOWN. OK/WARN/CRIT color the saved check verdict, not live fleet health. SELECT RUN means no Run ID is selected. VALID EMPTY means no saved provider check. Source unavailable means backend unavailable or request failure. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure indicates an unavailable source and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response.

panels.title: Inspect Selected Run Stages
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Saved stage rows for the exact Run ID; the table shows at most 12 stages. SUCCESS with missing stage evidence stays INCOMPLETE. A recorded zero stays 0. An unknown count is empty, not 0. UNFINISHED means no terminal event. Prometheus does not change this table. Request failure is Source unavailable. Removal counters are per-stage saved funnel removals; untracked stages stay UNKNOWN. Excluded % is excluded_by_contract / stage records in; Saved % is records out / stage records in. Empty or incomplete inputs are UNKNOWN. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure indicates an unavailable source and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response. Empty is a coverage gap: required saved evidence is missing, not a pass. Request failure is Source unavailable.

panels.title: Review Contract Exclusions
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Excluded-by-contract records summed across Bronze, Silver and Gold. Exclusion rate uses Bronze records out: below soft limit OK, at soft limit WARN, at hard limit CRIT. Limits come from pipeline configuration at dashboard generation, not historical run overrides. UNKNOWN means incomplete tracking or invalid counters; SELECT RUN requires a Run ID. Failed requests remain QUERY ERROR. Quarantined, filtered and deduplicated records are separate outcomes and are not included. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure indicates an unavailable source and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response. Empty is a coverage gap: required saved evidence is missing, not a pass. Request failure is Source unavailable. Empty evidence shows нет данных (excluded UNKNOWN), не применимо when no Run ID is selected, or нет записей when the catalog has no runs.

panels.title: Review FK Comparison Scope
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Persisted FK comparison in the exact parent workflow. selected-snapshot means absence only inside the pinned reference, not absence from the complete provider. Expiry can affect all selected rows while execution succeeds; remaining rows and scope stay explicit. Missing evidence is UNKNOWN and failed requests remain QUERY ERROR. Saved Evidence and Replay Readiness retain their independent checks. VALID EMPTY means an empty successful response; it does not replace UNKNOWN for missing required evidence. Backend failure indicates an unavailable source and must not be interpreted as an empty successful response. An empty comparison is not a blank table: не применимо means no Run ID is selected, нет записей means no runs are in scope, нет данных means FK comparison rows were not returned.
